verdict.rationale: The pack documents a REST API with API keys, delegated auth, webhooks, and a Power-Up Skeleton starter project. None of these is an official SDK or client library. The React/TypeScript sample is third-party (App Fox), and the MCP server is a separate capability, so the evidence shows no official SDKs to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
